description: This file declares functions related to error string retrieval for the cURL library, specifically strerror functions that convert error codes into human-readable strings. It also includes necessary headers and defines constants used within the library.

methods.name: Curl_strerror
methods.description: Provides a string description for a given error code, writing to a buffer.

methods.name: Curl_winapi_strerror
methods.description: Returns a string description of a Windows API error code, conditionally compiled for Windows platforms.

methods.name: Curl_sspi_strerror
methods.description: Returns a string description of an SSPI error code, conditionally compiled when USE_WINDOWS_SSPI is defined.
